complexDefinition.stringValue: Referring to the most recent in time or order.

definition.stringValue: The most recent in time or order.

text.stringValue: Самый последний во времени или последовательности.
**Last** night, I went to a concert.
My **last** vacation was in Italy.
The **last** message he sent was yesterday.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Following all others of the same kind in order or time.

definition.stringValue: Coming after all others.

text.stringValue: Приходящий после всех остальных.
**Last** night I finished reading my book.
The **last** page of the diary revealed his secrets.
He arrived **last** at the party.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Lowest in importance or rank; least desirable or satisfactory.

definition.stringValue: The least important or desirable.

text.stringValue: Наименее важный или желательный.
**Last** in line, he felt unimportant and overlooked.
She was always the **last** choice for the basketball team.
In his rankings, vegetables were always the **last** preference.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Used to emphasize the finality of a situation or action, expressing irrevocability.

definition.stringValue: Signifies the end of a situation.

text.stringValue: Обозначает окончание ситуации.
**Last** night's game ended the championship.
She sang her **last** song at the concert.
This was the **last** day of our vacation.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Pertaining to a final appearance or performance given by an actor or musician before retiring.

definition.stringValue: Related to the final performance before retirement.

text.stringValue: Относится к последнему представлению перед уходом на пенсию.
**Last** concert of the renowned pianist was truly unforgetable.
The actress's **last** performance received a standing ovation.
His **last** match before retirement was highly emotional.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Continue or remain in existence for a specified or unspecified period of time.

definition.stringValue: To continue or remain for a certain length of time.

text.stringValue: Продолжаться или оставаться в течение определенного промежутка времени.
The football match **lasted** two hours.
She hoped the celebration would **last** all night.
The movie **lasted** longer than expected.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Serve or perform adequately or well enough to continue in use or operation for a specified or reasonable period.

definition.stringValue: To work well enough for a reasonable amount of time.

text.stringValue: Хорошо работать достаточно разумное количество времени.
**Last** time, the water pump lasted only two months.
That flashlight should **last** through our entire camping trip.
I wonder how long this car will **last** without repairs.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To shape with a last, as in shoes or boots.

definition.stringValue: To shape shoes with a shoemaker's model.

text.stringValue: Формировать обувь с обувной моделью.
He learned to **last** shoes at his father's cobbling shop.
Craftsmanship in **lasting** shoes is crucial for a comfortable fit.
With time, she perfected the art of **lasting** elegant footwear.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Endure or survive under extreme hardship or adversity.

definition.stringValue: Survive in difficult conditions.

text.stringValue: Выживать в трудных условиях.
**Lasting** the winter was challenging but we managed it.
Will my old car **last** another year?
She didn't think her supplies would **last** the weekend.

complexDefinition.stringValue: Outdo, surpass, or outlast others, notably in a competition or struggle.

definition.stringValue: Surpass others in a competition.

text.stringValue: Превзойти других в соревновании.
**Last** through the finish line, he snatched the marathon victory.
Carla managed to **last** everyone in the 50m swimming race.
As a chess master, he knew he could **last** his opponents.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To say or do something for the last time, especially as a final gesture.

definition.stringValue: Get something done for the final time.

text.stringValue: Сделай что-то в последний раз.
I hope I **last** see him today as he leaves town.
Will she **last** wear that dress to the soiree tonight?
This will possibly be the day you **last** feed your cat fish.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In cricket, to bat or continue batting until the scheduled close of play.

definition.stringValue: Continue batting in cricket until play ends.

text.stringValue: Продолжай бить по мячу в крикет до окончания игры.
**Last** until the end of the cricket game, Ahmed!
She managed to **last** throughout the entire match.
We're hopeful he'll **last** till the final cricket innings.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In archaeology, to continue to be present or exist in a particular context or over a particular period of time, often used to refer to remnants or traces of past human activity.

definition.stringValue: To exist or be present over time in archaeology.

text.stringValue: Существовать или присутствовать на протяжении времени в археологии.
The ruins **lasted** remarkably intact over centuries.
Some ancient artifacts **last** surprisingly well in harsh conditions.
The cave paintings have **lasted** millennia.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In descriptive set theory, to have the highest rank.

definition.stringValue: Having the top rank in set theory.

text.stringValue: Имея высшее звание в теории множеств.
You **last** in mathematics with mastery over set theory.
His understanding of set theory allowed him to **last** academically.
Set theory knowledge lets her **last** among mathematical scholars.

complexDefinition.stringValue: The last person or thing; i.e., the individual or item in a series that comes after all others.

definition.stringValue: The last individual or thing in a series.

text.stringValue: Последний индивидуум или вещь в серии.
**Last** in line always gets the leftovers.
She was the **last** to leave the party.
The **last** chapter of the book was my favorite.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A shoemaker's model for shaping or repairing a shoe or boot.

definition.stringValue: A model used by shoemakers for shaping shoes.

text.stringValue: Модель, используемая обувщиками для формовки обуви.
**Last** craftsmanship is essential for custom-made shoes.
He adjusted the **last** to fit the customer's foot correctly.
The shoes were formed on an antique wooden **last**.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A final demand or statement made to reinforce a point.

definition.stringValue: A strong final statement.

text.stringValue: Сильное заключительное заявление.
**Last** of his valedictorian speech left everyone speechless.
Her **last** in the debate ensured her victory.
His **last** at the press conference became a headline.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A person's dying act; the last thing done before death.

definition.stringValue: The final act before death.

text.stringValue: Последний акт перед смертью.
**Last** wish was to see her grandchildren once more.
His **last** words were filled with love and longing.
Her **last** breath was a whisper of goodbye.

complexDefinition.stringValue: The course or route taken by an aircraft or ship on its most recent flight or voyage.

definition.stringValue: The recent route of a ship or aircraft.

text.stringValue: Недавний маршрут корабля или самолета.
*The captain checked the **last** before changing course.*
*They updated the **last** after the unexpected detour.*
*She studied the **last** to determine their course of action.*

complexDefinition.stringValue: A unit of weight or capacity used in the British imperial system, specifically for herring, wool, or other commodities.

definition.stringValue: A unit of weight or capacity in British system.

text.stringValue: Единица измерения веса или объема в британской системе.
The wool weighed two **last**.
They ordered five **last** of oranges.
The freight train carries twelve **last** of coal.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A couplet or short verse at the end of a longer poem or song, often summarizing or repeating the key theme.

definition.stringValue: The final short verse of a long poem or song.

text.stringValue: Последний короткий стих длинного стихотворения или песни.
**Last** of the song always leaves a profound impact.
The **last** of the sonnet held the most poignant message.
In the epic, the **last** unraveled the unexpected twist.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In the stock market, the last recorded trading price of a security.

definition.stringValue: The final recorded price of a stock.

text.stringValue: Финальная зафиксированная цена акции.
**Last** of Apple stocks took a sudden dip today.
The **last** for Microsoft shares remained steady throughout the week.
The **last** for Amazon greatly increased after the product launch.

complexDefinition.stringValue: The concluding or closing part of a time or event, notably denoting the final stages of life.

definition.stringValue: The end part of something.

text.stringValue: Конечная часть чего-либо.
**Last** month was hectic with so many deadlines.
My favorite book in the Harry Potter series is the **last**.
On the **last** page, the mystery finally unraveled.

complexDefinition.stringValue: After everything else; ultimately.

definition.stringValue: After everything else.

text.stringValue: После всего остального.
I locked the door **last**.
Hannah arrived **last** at the party.
He added the icing **last**.
